하얗다.n: Vivid, bright, pure white, like snow; more descriptive and expressive.
cf: 희다
to be white
Plainer, more neutral and written word; very common as a modifier

빗나가다.e: to miss the mark; to turn out wrong; to go astray
빗나가다.n: arrow, ball or guess misses the mark; person going astray
cf: 결장하다
to miss; to be sidelined; to sit out
sports; a player is absent from a match, e.g. from injury
놓치다
to miss; to lose hold of; to let slip
missing a bus, chance or grip; everyday
빠지다
to miss; to be absent from; to fall into
everyday; absent from class or a gathering, also falling into water or coming out

귓가.e: rim of the ear; area near the ear

귓전

드넓다.e: to be vast; to be extensive; to be wide open
드넓다.n: native Korean, vivid and literary, for fields, sea, sky
cf: 광대하다
to be vast; to be extensive; to be immense
Sino-Korean, formal or written, for great scale of land or knowledge
